name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new database, configuration option, or improvement
title: "[FEAT] <short description>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: aslamabdika18
---

## Type of Request
- [ ] Add a new database (e.g., MariaDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch)
- [ ] Improve an existing configuration
- [ ] Add a new GUI tool option
- [ ] Improve documentation
- [ ] Other

## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you are requesting.

## Use Case
Explain the problem this feature would solve or the workflow it would improve.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you think this should be implemented. Include example config snippets if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional Context
Any other context, links, or screenshots relevant to the request.
